description: A Python module implementing a thread-safe JSON file-based database for managing users and journal entries, including CRUD operations, search, and concurrency controls.

classes.name: JSONDatabase
classes.description: Thread-safe class providing JSON file-based storage for users and journal entries with CRUD and search functionalities.

methods.name: __init__(self, data_dir: str = "data")
methods.description: Initializes the JSONDatabase instance, setting data directory paths and ensuring data files exist.

methods.name: _ensure_data_directory(self)
methods.description: Creates the data directory and initializes 'users.json' and 'entries.json' files if they do not exist.

methods.name: Lock _get_file_lock(self, filepath: str)
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a file lock for concurrency control on specific JSON files.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _read_json_file(self, filepath: str)
methods.description: Safely reads data from a JSON file with shared locking.

methods.name: bool _write_json_file(self, filepath: str, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Safely writes data to a JSON file with exclusive locking.

methods.name: Optional[str] create_user(self, user_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new user, assigns a unique ID, and saves to 'users.json'.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_user_by_id(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves user data by user ID.

methods.name: bool update_user(self, user_id: str, update_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates existing user data based on user ID.

methods.name: bool delete_user(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Performs a soft delete on a user by setting 'is_active' to False.

methods.name: Optional[str] create_entry(self, entry_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a new journal entry associated with a user.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_entry_by_id(self, entry_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves a journal entry by its ID.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] get_entries_by_user(self, user_id: str, limit: int = 20, offset: int = 0)
methods.description: Retrieves paginated journal entries for a specific user.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] search_entries(self, user_id: str, search_params: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Searches journal entries with filters such as query text, mood, tags, and date range.

methods.name: bool update_entry(self, entry_id: str, user_id: str, update_data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Updates a journal entry if owned by the specified user.

methods.name: bool delete_entry(self, entry_id: str, user_id: str)
methods.description: Soft deletes a journal entry if owned by the specified user.

methods.name: int get_user_entry_count(self, user_id: str)
methods.description: Counts total non-deleted journal entries for a user.
